other_conditions: Must own agricultural land in West Bengal
Eligibility may be limited to certain types of crops (e.g., food or cash crops)
Specific size of landholding may be required
Previous participation in other agricultural schemes may affect eligibility
Income criteria may apply (details not specified)
benefits_summary: Provides subsidies (₹5,000‑₹25,000) to help farmers purchase inputs and improve crop quality and productivity.
